diagnosis: The checks C2 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to scheduling 60 appointments based on the 'appointments_scheduled' fact (S3). This fact was always available to the lone decision-maker, allowing the model to satisfy the appointment scheduling requirement without needing the hidden information provided by PF1, PF2, or PF3.
